description: Use for salaries and net pay in EU countries, how Polish pay compares with the EU or one country, and how a given net salary in PLN compares with the average in each EU country. For minimum wages, use get_europe_data. Annual net earnings (take-home pay after income tax and employee social contributions, plus family allowances) in the 27 EU countries from Eurostat earn_nt_net, yearly, by household type: single person, couples with and without children, single parent, low (67%) and high (167%) wage. Ranking in EUR and in purchasing power standards (PPS, adjusted for price levels), gross pay, tax and contributions, hourly labour cost of employers (lc_lci_lev), tax wedge of a low-wage single earner, the finwire index finwire_eu_net_wage_gap (Poland as % of the EU average in PPS) and the history of Poland and one comparison country. With salary (monthly net in PLN) it compares that pay with the average of the same household type in every EU country, in EUR and PPS, and gives the monthly EUR amount with the same purchasing power.

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history next to Poland, default DE.

household.description: Household type, default single (single person without children, average wage).

salary.description: Monthly net salary in PLN to compare with every EU country.

name: get_eu_earnings
title: Net earnings in EU countries (Eurostat)
